title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Summer Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Summer Edition Pre Filled Pods bring warm-weather flavour to the Elf Bar Dual 10K. One pod pairs creamy Banana with a cooling Ice finish, while the other delivers sweet, smooth Mango for a sun-soaked tropical vape. The integrated 5ml refill design ensures extended vaping without bottle top-ups, supported by the Dual 10K auto-refill system. Together, this duo captures the comfort and brightness of summer with every puff. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
